title: English - Literary Studies Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Humanities [HUM]

Electives

Arts [ARTS]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

Social Sciences [SSCI]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

HUMANITY Elective
HUMANTIY Electives: At least one from HUMANITY 101, 103, 302 [M], 303, 304, 335, 350, 410, or 450 is required.  Upper-division HUMANITY courses are not recommended for first-year students.

Diversity [DIVR]

Two from ENGLISH 370, 371, 372, or 373

Complete University Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 302 [M]

300-400-level Literature or Humanities Elective
Approved 300 - 400-level Literature or Humanities Electives: Approved courses include ENGLISH 305, 306, 309, 311, 315, 317, 322, 332, 341, 366, 370, 371, 372, 373, 409, 419, 470, 480-489; HUM 302 [M], 304, 335, 350, 410, 450. Will need to include [M] course to meet University Requirements.

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Elective

300-400-level Literature or Humanities Electives
Approved 300 - 400-level Literature or Humanities Electives: Approved courses include ENGLISH 305, 306, 309, 311, 315, 317, 322, 332, 341, 366, 370, 371, 372, 373, 409, 419, 470, 480-489; HUM 302 [M], 304, 335, 350, 410, 450. Will need to include [M] course to meet University Requirements.

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Electives

ENGLISH 494 or 400-level Literature or Humanities Elective
Approved 400-level Literature or Humanities courses include ENGLISH 409, 419, 470, 480-489, HUM 410, 450, or as approved by advisor.

Writers of Color Course
Writers of Color Courses: Choose from ENGLISH 220, 222, 310, 311, 315 [M], 316, 322 [M], 341 [M], 345 [M], 489, or CES 331.

300-400-level Electives

Complete Senior Exit Survey

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

A student may be admitted to the English – Literary Studies Option upon making their intention known to the department.

Requirements in this degree include 15 credits of core classes, 15 credits 300-400-level English literature or Humanities classes, including at least 6 credits at the 400 level, and 6 credits of electives in English or Humanities at any level, including a Writers of Color course and excluding ENGLISH 201.
